purpose: Retrospective authoritative check that no accepted original childes-db age adjustment was applied to a current ASR transcript whose ASR comment was omitted from the provisional extraction metadata

inputs.archive_manifest_digest_definition: SHA-256 of canonical compact JSON plus newline for the sorted accepted archive records, retaining archive_id, collection, corpus, source_url, download_date, sha256, and bytes from extraction metadata

method.source: Authoritative current CHAT member bytes from each source ZIP recorded in extraction metadata
steps: Group accepted (collection, transcript) keys by recorded archive_id.
Resolve each transcript to its recorded ZIP member and require that member to exist.
Decode member bytes as UTF-8 with BOM handling and replacement auditing.
Restrict inspection to the CHAT header before the first main speaker tier.
Read every @Comment tier, including continuation lines, and search case-insensitively for ASR.

conclusion: No accepted original childes-db age adjustment needs to be reverted for an ASR flag omitted from provisional extraction annotation_comments.
